Alex W: Quick sync re: INC-912 postmortem — doc is up https://docs.internal/redwood/incidents/INC-912-rca. We need firm owners + due dates for the remaining action items so we can close the loop with legal/compliance. Can folks ack and assign by EOD today?

Priya S: I can own 'KV cache warming strategy' and the follow-up runbook. Target date: 2026-04-02. Will add a short PR with checklist. @Dan K FYI for rollout gating. :white_check_mark:

Dan K: Ack. I'll take 'canary fallback config' and the test plan. ETA 2026-03-30. Will drop test matrix in the ticket. @Maria P can you review the SLO wording?

Maria P: Yes, I can review SLO wording. Also will check the telemetry gaps item — noted that retention parity was off for shards 3-5. I'll propose a retention policy change by 2026-03-29. :+1:

Alex W: Thanks. Two cross-team asks: security wants a short threat-model note for the new fallback (tiny doc), and infra wants a migration window for the config change. Can we add owners for those?

Priya S: I can do the security note as part of the runbook (short, 1-2 paragraphs). Marking due 2026-03-31.

Dan K: Infra migration window — tagging @eng-infra but I'll propose a 2-hour maintenance window on 2026-04-05, in UTC. If infra pushes back we'll negotiate.

Maria P: For product/PM signoff we need Dana to confirm the user-visible behavior. Alex, can you ping product?

Alex W: Will ping product now. @Dana T please chime in on PM signoff timeline.

eng-oncall-bot: Incident INC-912 marked RESOLVED by Alex W at 2026-03-18T14:12:03Z

Dana T (via Alex W): Dana responded in thread: "I can review the user-visible notes tomorrow AM and sign off if no regressions. PM signoff target 2026-03-26."

Dan K: Summarizing owners/due dates so it's easy to copy into the tracking sheet:
```
- KV cache runbook: Priya S — 2026-04-02
- Canary fallback config & tests: Dan K — 2026-03-30
- Telemetry/retention parity: Maria P — 2026-03-29
- Security threat note: Priya S — 2026-03-31
- Infra migration window: Dan K (proposed) — 2026-04-05
- PM signoff: Dana T — 2026-03-26
```

Priya S: I'll create the tickets and add assignees + links by EOD.

Alex W: Perfect. Final ask: if you pick up an item, please add a short acceptance test in the ticket and mark the postmortem doc with the ticket link when done. Closing the loop, will re-open if any owner moves a date. Thx all. :raised_hands:
